summary: Beautica has eight named doctors and a full range of treatments, but the homepage shows zeros, copied text and dead links.

findings.problem: Counters appear to show 0 for patients, doctors and Google reviews. The testimonials area shows placeholder text (Award, Type, Project).
findings.cost: Zeros and placeholders make a clinic look unfinished, the opposite of proof.
findings.fix: Real numbers, Google reviews and patient stories.

findings.problem: Service text is in the wrong place: root canal text under Aesthetic and Cosmetic, crowns under Bridges, braces under Scanners. Several sentences stop mid way.
findings.cost: Patients reading about veneers or implants get confused and leave.

findings.problem: Logo, slider and many card links go to # or are empty. Images use dummy.png and the alt text says 'denatal'.
findings.cost: Broken links and weak SEO lose both visitors and Google traffic.
findings.fix: Working links and proper image text.

findings.problem: The contact form shows only a privacy line, no visible fields. No email is listed. No before and after.
findings.cost: Patients who want a form or email have no option except WhatsApp or phone.
findings.fix: A short form, one booking path and a results gallery.

redesign: Real counters, reviews and before and after proof.
One accurate page per treatment, with a booking form and WhatsApp.
